title: Old Style Sickles (BTA! Refit)
description: Changes swords to look like sickles. Made for Better Than Adventure!
body:
Changes swords in Better Than Adventure! to look like sickles. Contains the steel variant and changed gold colours in contrast to my base texture pack. All sword names remain unchanged, so the in-game items will still be called "[XYZ Material] Sword".
![View of the new sword textures both held and in the hotbar.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1906515c82d23764e8824f98229bc1e46d288813.jpeg)
